verdict.rationale: The README shows a single-command install path (`npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills`), plus a non-interactive variant targeting a specific agent. skills.sh itself pitches installing "with a single command." A runtime probe confirmed the CLI runs keylessly from npm with no account, switches to promptless mode when an agent drives it, and lists a repo's skills before install, so going from nothing to an installed skill is plausibly a few minutes. Missing for 10: a hands-on probe showing an actual `add` completing and the skill working in an agent, and a dedicated step-by-step quickstart page with time-to-first-skill guidance (the .md docs probe returned 404).
